title: Seismic Museum
description: A walkthrough of the Seismic Museum: from the night forecourt, down through the entry vaults to the concourse, out along the Noxx and Xealist halls, and up the steps of the grand hall to the Keeper’s Gallery.

rooms.name: Forecourt
rooms.description: The night plaza and the two entrance gates.

panoramas.title: Forecourt
panoramas.description: The dark forecourt outside the museum at night, where the illuminated entrance pavilion carrying the words Seismic Museum stands alone on an empty plaza.

poster.alt: Night-time plaza, empty and dark, with a small illuminated pavilion in the distance reading Seismic Museum.

panoramas.title: West Gate
panoramas.description: The western entrance gate: a lit portal framed by checkered panels and slender scaffolding, open onto the dark plaza.

poster.alt: A lit museum entrance portal framed by black and white checkered panels at night.

panoramas.title: East Gate
panoramas.description: The eastern entrance gate, mirroring the western portal on the far side of the forecourt.

poster.alt: A second lit museum entrance portal with checkered framing, mirroring the west gate.

rooms.name: Entry Vaults
rooms.description: The two vaulted approaches down to the concourse.

panoramas.title: West Vault
panoramas.description: Inside the western entry vault, a soft pink chamber whose folded walls funnel visitors down toward the concourse.

poster.alt: Interior of a smooth pink vaulted chamber narrowing toward a lit opening ahead.

hotspots.label: Through the tunnel to the concourse

panoramas.title: East Vault
panoramas.description: Inside the eastern entry vault, mirroring the western approach down to the concourse.

poster.alt: Interior of a smooth pink vaulted chamber, mirror of the west vault, narrowing toward a lit opening.

hotspots.label: Through the tunnel to the concourse

rooms.name: Main Concourse
rooms.description: The ticket concourse and the gates to both halls.

panoramas.title: Main Concourse
panoramas.description: The main concourse beneath the entrance stairs: a checkerboard floor under a ribbed ceiling, with a ticket desk between two circular portals leading to the Noxx and Xealist halls.

poster.alt: A wide pink concourse with a black and white checkered floor, ribbed ceiling, ticket desk and two round portals.

panoramas.title: Noxx Concourse
panoramas.description: The Noxx side of the concourse, dominated by a circular tunnel portal set into a dark wall, with the museum welcome text on one side and a ticket booth on the other.

poster.alt: A concourse wall with a large round tunnel portal, wall text panels and a ticket booth.

panoramas.title: Welcome Wall
panoramas.description: The welcome wall of the Seismic Museum, whose introductory text stands beside the tunnel portal into the Noxx Hall.

poster.alt: A dark museum wall carrying an introductory welcome text next to a round tunnel portal.

hotspots.label: About the museum
hotspots.title: Welcome to the Seismic Museum
hotspots.body: The welcome text on this wall introduces the museum as a shared cultural memory — a collection assembled from the imagination of a community rather than from a single author.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall Gate
panoramas.description: The gate to the Noxx Hall, where the hall name and its wall text face a ticket booth beside the tunnel portal.

poster.alt: A museum wall reading The Noxx Hall beside a ticket booth and a round tunnel portal.

hotspots.label: About the Noxx Hall
hotspots.title: The Noxx Hall
hotspots.body: One of the museum’s two great halls. Its galleries run in a long arc of bays, each given over to works from a different maker in the collection.

panoramas.title: Xealist Concourse
panoramas.description: The Xealist side of the concourse, with its own circular tunnel portal, wall text and ticket booth.

poster.alt: A concourse wall with a round tunnel portal, wall text and a ticket booth on the Xealist side.

panoramas.title: Statement Wall
panoramas.description: The museum statement wall, describing a collection that sets out to preserve not only what exists but what could exist.

poster.alt: A dark museum wall carrying the Seismic Museum statement text beside a round tunnel portal.

hotspots.label: The collection
hotspots.title: Seismic Museum
hotspots.body: The statement on this wall frames the collection as a living archive: it preserves what exists, and equally the work of artists who reimagined the world in their own vision.

panoramas.title: Xealist Hall Gate
panoramas.description: The gate to the Xealist Hall, its wall text standing beside the ticket booth and the tunnel portal.

poster.alt: A museum wall reading The Xealist Hall beside a ticket booth and a round tunnel portal.

hotspots.label: About the Xealist Hall
hotspots.title: The Xealist Hall
hotspots.body: The museum’s second great hall, laid out as a mirror of the Noxx Hall: a chain of gallery bays gathered around a central arch under an open black sky.

rooms.name: The Noxx Hall
rooms.description: Eight gallery bays reached through the Noxx tunnel.

panoramas.title: Noxx Passage
panoramas.description: Inside the tunnel to the Noxx Hall, where a circular opening ahead frames the first gallery bay.

poster.alt: The inside of a smooth tunnel, with a bright circular opening ahead showing a gallery beyond.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 1
panoramas.description: Bay 1 of the Noxx Hall: framed works on easels ranged around a classical arch, a name plaque standing before them, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with framed works on easels around a classical arch, with a name plaque on a stand in the foreground, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 2
panoramas.description: Bay 2 of the Noxx Hall: a tall arch flanked by portrait works, with columns and a distant temple front beyond, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with an arch, portrait works on easels and columns behind, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 3
panoramas.description: Bay 3 of the Noxx Hall: a slender dark monolith rising beside the bay, with works ranged along the wall, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with a tall dark spire and framed works on stands, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 4
panoramas.description: Bay 4 of the Noxx Hall: a domed vitrine at the centre of the bay, with works and a plaque set around it, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with a domed display case and framed works on easels, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 5
panoramas.description: Bay 5 of the Noxx Hall: an arched niche holding a single work, with further pieces stepping away along the wall, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with an arched niche and a row of framed works, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 6
panoramas.description: Bay 6 of the Noxx Hall: a broad arch carrying a large canvas, with a name plaque angled before it, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with a wide arch, a large canvas and a plaque on a stand, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 7
panoramas.description: Bay 7 of the Noxx Hall: a colonnaded front rising behind the easels, with figures standing among the works, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with a colonnaded front, easels and standing figures, on a black and white checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Noxx Hall — Bay 8
panoramas.description: Bay 8 of the Noxx Hall: the last bay of the hall, opening toward the grand hall beyond the columns, under an open black sky above the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A gallery bay in the Noxx Hall with the final bay, opening toward a large hall in the distance, on a black and white checkered floor.

rooms.name: The Xealist Hall
rooms.description: Eight gallery bays reached through the Xealist tunnel.

panoramas.title: Xealist Passage
panoramas.description: Inside the tunnel to the Xealist Hall, the first gallery bay visible through the circular opening ahead.

poster.alt: The inside of a smooth tunnel, with a bright circular opening ahead showing a gallery beyond.

rooms.name: Grand Hall
rooms.description: The rotunda where both halls meet, and its colonnade.

panoramas.title: Grand Hall
panoramas.description: The grand hall at the heart of the museum: a columned rotunda raised on a broad flight of steps and lit from within, with statues and exhibition stands ranged around the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A pink columned rotunda on a wide flight of steps, glowing blue within, surrounded by statues on a checkered floor.

panoramas.title: Colonnade
panoramas.description: The colonnade beside the grand hall, where columns and display plinths stand around an attendant on the checkerboard floor.

poster.alt: A row of pink columns and cylindrical plinths with a uniformed attendant standing among them.

rooms.name: The Keeper’s Gallery
rooms.description: The inner room above the grand hall steps.

panoramas.title: The Keeper’s Gallery
panoramas.description: The Keeper of Community Faces: an inner room where a wall of glowing portrait cards faces a low plinth between heavy columns.

poster.alt: A dim room with a glowing blue wall of portrait cards facing a low plinth between columns.
